pages.title: Jingle Mahjong
pages.creator: ByteBelle Studio
pages.description:
Jingle Mahjong is a Christmas tile puzzle in which you remove matching pairs to clear each board. Look for identical gifts, candy canes, decorations, and gingerbread designs among the festive tiles.

The levels take you through Santaland's snowy setting and Bubbleland's candy scenery, with stars to collect as you progress. If you cannot find another pair, hints can help you locate a match, while a shuffle offers another way to get the board moving. Work through the layouts, clear their tiles, and continue through both themed worlds.

pages.title: K-Pop Halloween Dress Up
pages.creator: Gamerina
pages.description: Dress the idols for a spooky celebration in K-Pop Halloween Dress Up. Combine witch, vampire, pumpkin, and other costumes with accessories and face paint. Create a Halloween look for each girl by mixing the available pieces.

pages.title: Pixel Tetrix Trails
pages.creator: Fantasy Realm
pages.description: Rebuild pixel pictures from shaped blocks in Pixel Tetrix Trails. Drag every piece into the artwork before the timer expires, using the placement highlights to check its fit. Ninety levels offer different arrangements, and a hint can reveal a piece's position.

pages.title: Caterfall 2048
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Drop numbered cats onto a hexagonal board in Caterfall 2048. Adjacent equal cats merge into a larger value and add to your score. Choose each column carefully, because the game ends when the field has no empty cells.

pages.title: Teacher Simulator Christmas Exam
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Run a festive classroom in Teacher Simulator Christmas Exam. Hand out exam papers, mark answers, and manage class activities as the holiday teacher. Different school days bring subjects such as art, geography, and mathematics.

pages.title: Epic Stunts PvP 3D
pages.creator: Fuego! Games
pages.description: Drive a muscle car around a stunt city in Epic Stunts PvP 3D. Customize your vehicle and try three driving modes. A second player can join on the same keyboard for head-to-head contests with separate steering controls.

pages.title: Toka Boka Home Clean Up Design
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Help a newly arrived family settle in with Toka Boka Home Clean Up Design. Remove dust, tidy clothes, and repair damaged belongings. Combine cleaning jobs with decorating choices to transform the family's home.

pages.title: Purrfect Bakery
pages.creator: Orenji Spark
pages.description: Run a cat's bakery in Purrfect Bakery. Prepare and serve treats for animal customers, then continue building the business as new visitors become available. Use the mouse or touch controls to interact with the bakery's tasks.

pages.title: Cooking Stories: Fun cafe game
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: Manage restaurants and makeovers in Cooking Stories: Fun cafe game. Serve guests promptly as part of a transformation television show, then help each participant with clothing, makeup, and home design. New characters bring different businesses and interiors to work on.

pages.title: sprunki character maker OC
pages.creator: jimo game
pages.description: Design an original character in sprunki character maker OC. Choose and modify features from the available customization options to assemble your own Sprunki-style creation. Experiment with different combinations until the character has the appearance you want.

pages.title: WorldCraft 3
pages.creator: AngryGamez
pages.description: Explore and reshape a block world in WorldCraft 3. Break blocks, place new ones, and select items from your inventory. Flying lets you move around the pixel landscape, while grenades provide another way to destroy blocks.

pages.title: RiddleMath
pages.creator: Felicity Games
pages.description: Place numbers into logic puzzles in RiddleMath. Examine each mathematical arrangement and decide which values belong in its empty spaces. Click a number and a destination on a computer, or drag it into place using touch controls.

pages.title: Xmas Presents Mahjong
pages.creator: bestphysics
pages.description: Collect festive tiles in Xmas Presents Mahjong. Move tiles into the holding spaces below the board and gather three of the same design to remove them. Plan which tiles to take as you work through the arrangement.

pages.title: Cube Stories: Escape
pages.creator: Mirra Games
pages.description: Escape an abandoned mansion in Cube Stories: Escape. Follow a video blogger through rooms filled with objects, riddles, and clues about the house's past. Click or move items to solve the puzzles that block the way out.

pages.title: American Block Sniper Online
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Clear hostile forces from a block-built city in American Block Sniper Online. Move between buildings, collect weapons, and eliminate every enemy before the level's timer expires. Use aimed shots, grenades, and weapon changes to handle different positions.

pages.title: Build and Run
pages.creator: Cubehole
pages.description: Construct a route while sprinting in Build and Run. Use the build button to fill gaps with horizontal sections, slopes, and ramps. Choose the right moment to create each missing part and carry the runner past dangerous traps.

pages.title: Biking Extreme 3D
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Race mountain bikes through hazardous tracks in Biking Extreme 3D. Knock rival riders out of the way while keeping clear of trees and rocks that end your attempt. Spend earned coins on bike improvements and try the other characters.

pages.title: Meow Slide
pages.creator: Friendzy
pages.description: Slide cat-shaped blocks sideways in Meow Slide. Complete horizontal rows to remove them and free space on the board. Keep clearing lines so unfinished rows cannot build up to the top.

pages.title: Butterfly Match Mastery
pages.creator: NovaSky
pages.description: Release butterflies by pairing identical wings in Butterfly Match Mastery. Connect matching tiles using a route of no more than three straight segments. Find the available pairs and clear them before the timer runs out.

pages.title: Telekinesis Attack
pages.creator: Butcher's Games
pages.description: Throw opponents with psychic power in Telekinesis Attack. Hold an enemy and drag in different directions before flinging them away. Use objects in the environment and take opponents' weapons as you work to defeat everyone.

pages.title: Funny Cars Route
pages.creator: Itmium Limited
pages.description: Draw driving paths in Funny Cars Route. Connect each car to a parking space of the same color, then start the vehicles once every route is ready. Plan the paths and their approach directions to park all the cars.

pages.title: Kingdoms Wars
pages.creator: ISS Game Studio
pages.description: Buy streets and build hotels in Kingdoms Wars. Roll the dice to travel around the board, collect rent, and improve your properties. Bonus cards, jail, royal fees, and stays at rival hotels can change your fortunes.

pages.title: Mike And Mia Camping Day
pages.creator: iclickgames
pages.description: Prepare an outdoor trip in Mike And Mia Camping Day. Dress the children, put up their tent, and take part in campsite activities. Look for animals and flowers and catch bugs during their day outdoors.

pages.title: Monster Truck High Speed
pages.creator: Vitalitygames.com
pages.description: Drive a large truck through turns in Monster Truck High Speed. Accelerate, steer, and drift around bends while maintaining control. Use WASD or the arrow keys to drive and the space bar to brake.

pages.title: US Army Vehicle Transporter Truck
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Deliver military vehicles in US Army Vehicle Transporter Truck. Load cars and tanks onto the carrier, drive them to the designated base, and unload them for the mission. Some jobs require driving the cargo vehicles themselves as well as the transport truck.

pages.title: Gurido3
pages.creator: Okashi Games
pages.description: Place numbered tiles to form merges in Gurido3. Each turn gives you three pieces to arrange on the board. Combine equal numbers into larger values and use bonus tiles earned through high scores to help extend your progress.

pages.title: Color Drop
pages.creator: kidsgamesplay
pages.description: Guide a colored ball through rotating shapes in Color Drop. Pass only through sections that match the ball's color. Tap to control its movement and wait for an opening when circles, crosses, or several obstacles overlap.

pages.title: Superfighters
pages.creator: MythoLogic Interactive
pages.description: Fight through weapon-filled arenas in Superfighters. Pick up arms and take on opponents while keeping away from explosive crates. Try to be the last fighter standing, or team up with a friend in the cooperative option.

pages.title: Super Solitaire
pages.creator: ConteZero
pages.description: Choose Klondike, Golf, or Freecell in Super Solitaire. Build suit foundations in Klondike and Freecell, or remove cards one rank above or below the waste card in Golf. Each variation offers a different way to clear the deal.

pages.title: Parking Escape
pages.creator: tinyDream
pages.description: Free vehicles from a crowded lot in Parking Escape. Swipe cars out in an order that opens space for the others. Look for the vehicle with a clear route before moving on to the next blocked car.

pages.title: Halloween Party 2021 Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Assemble nine seasonal pictures in Halloween Party 2021 Puzzle. Select an image and a layout with 16, 36, 64, or 100 pieces. Fit the scattered parts together to complete each Halloween scene.

pages.title: Vegas Clash 3D
pages.creator: Freeway Interactive
pages.description: Raid a casino with an Elvis-styled gang in Vegas Clash 3D. Carry cash bags from the underground vault to the waiting van while fighting the police. Earn stars in battles to improve your character and seek stronger weapons around the building.

pages.title: Street Food Master
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Prepare Chinese street food in Street Food Master. Follow the cooking tasks to make spicy noodles and rice cakes in the kitchen. Use the mouse to handle the ingredients and complete each recipe.

pages.title: Bomb Prank
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Pass an explosive between players in Bomb Prank. Move through the arena and hand off the bomb before its countdown ends. Keep track of who is carrying it and avoid being left with it at the final moment.

pages.title: Crewmates and Impostors Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Rebuild twelve character pictures in Crewmates and Impostors Jigsaw. Finish the first puzzle to unlock the next image. Choose between 25, 49, and 100 pieces for each scene, then fit its parts back together.

pages.title: Christmas Puzzle
pages.creator: GameBiz
pages.description: Serve candy requests within a move limit in Christmas Puzzle. Swap sweets to form matches of three, and make larger combinations for special candies. Hammers, bombs, and other helpers can remove difficult pieces as you work toward each customer's order.

pages.title: Scary Makeover Halloween Pet Salon
pages.creator: Yiv.Com
pages.description: Give Kiki and Fifi festive transformations in Scary Makeover Halloween Pet Salon. Bathe the pets, style their hair, and choose colorful costumes. Finish preparing for Halloween by decorating their haunted house.

pages.title: Cute Kitty Car Jigsaw
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Put together six pictures in Cute Kitty Car Jigsaw. Choose a 25-, 49-, or 100-piece puzzle and move the pieces into the right positions. Compare colors and edges to restore the selected kitty-and-car image.

pages.title: Mass Madness
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Join a street uprising in Mass Madness. Move through the action, attack opponents, and switch between the available weapons. WASD handles movement, the space bar attacks, and number keys select your weapon.

pages.title: Heist Run
pages.creator: Babil Studios
pages.description: Outrun the policeman in Heist Run. Guide the escaping character toward the finish and try to make it through the pursuit. Use WASD and the left mouse button to control the run.

pages.title: Flow Lines
pages.creator: Game-Devs
pages.description: Connect equal colors across a grid in Flow Lines. Link every pair and fill the whole board with your routes. Work through fifty puzzles, planning paths so each color has the space it needs.

pages.title: Blockcraft Cars Hidden Keys
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Search for concealed keys in Blockcraft Cars Hidden Keys. Find ten in each of six pictures before time expires. Avoid repeated guesses, because clicking the wrong places costs additional seconds.

pages.title: Square Bird
pages.creator: GameBake Ltd
pages.description: Build a tower of eggs to lift your bird over barriers in Square Bird. Make the tower just tall enough for a perfect landing. Three perfect landings activate Fever mode, letting the bird fire blocks through obstacles ahead.

pages.title: Mortar Watermelon
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Aim a watermelon basket through thirty-six puzzle levels in Mortar Watermelon. Collect fruit along the route and reach the goal while avoiding blades and other hazards. Adjust your aim before launching the next movement.

pages.title: Colors
pages.creator: DoxxaSoft
pages.description: Collect keys by matching their colors in Colors. Combine primary colors to produce the shade needed for each key. Check the next key before mixing so you can gather them all.

pages.title: Ragdoll Physics
pages.creator: Bubito
pages.description: Experiment with a falling character in Ragdoll Physics. Grab the boneless girl with the left mouse button and pull her around as she descends through a seemingly bottomless pit. Watch how the ragdoll reacts to your movements.

pages.title: Kung Fu Fury
pages.creator: Zibotronic
pages.description: Choose your next move in Kung Fu Fury. Face an opponent in short bouts and select a combat option for each exchange. Luck plays a part in deciding how the confrontation turns out.

pages.title: Kids Country Flag Quiz
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: Test your flag knowledge in Kids Country Flag Quiz. Look at the flag and country choices, then select the matching answer. Continue through the questions to practice recognizing the national designs.

pages.title: Ball and Target
pages.creator: Jam Game Studio
pages.description: Send a ball toward its target in Ball and Target. Click or tap to time each attempt and score successful hits. Keep up as the speed increases and avoid using up your three misses.

pages.title: Miss Jenny Wants Food
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Catch food for a hungry character in Miss Jenny Wants Food. Move quickly to collect the edible items while avoiding everything else. Missing eight pieces of food or catching a non-food object ends the game.

pages.title: Robuxs Spin Wheel Earn RBX
pages.creator: yaine
pages.description: Spin for points in Robuxs Spin Wheel Earn RBX. The game provides two wheels, with the second offering a chance to increase your score or lose it. Decide whether to take the bonus risk after a spin.

pages.title: Birds Slide
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Rearrange picture tiles in Birds Slide. Choose one of three bird images and a puzzle mode, then slide the sections into their correct order. Use the image details to guide each move toward the finished picture.

pages.title: Balls Rugby Flick
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Flick balls toward the goal in Balls Rugby Flick. You begin with three attempts and must account for wind and the opponent's gloves. Hit target signs to earn bonuses and opportunities for extra balls.

pages.title: Watch The Clock
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Stop the hand at the right moment in Watch The Clock. Tap when the rotating pointer reaches the indicated number. Watch its approach closely so your input lands on the mark rather than passing it.

pages.title: Candy Match 3 Deluxe
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Make candy combinations in Candy Match 3 Deluxe. Drag sweets into matches of three and build your score as the pieces clear. Look for another matching group after each move to keep the board working for you.

pages.title: Professor Bubble Shooter
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Aim colored bubbles in Professor Bubble Shooter. Help the professor bring matching potion ingredients together by shooting into the arrangement above. Choose the direction of each shot to build useful groups rather than scattering colors.

pages.title: Arabian Tic Tac Toe
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Play a noughts-and-crosses contest in Arabian Tic Tac Toe. Take turns placing your mark while watching your opponent's choices. Build a winning line and block the other player's attempts to complete one first.

pages.title: Christmas Jigsaw Puzzle
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Piece together holiday landscapes in Christmas Jigsaw Puzzle. Select a picture and adjust the grid size for the amount of detail you want. Drag the parts into position to restore the complete seasonal scene.

pages.title: 25 December
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Merge matching calendar dates in 25 December. Move the pieces with arrow keys or swipes, combining identical dates into the next one. Work toward December 25 and use the limited shuffle or regroup options when the board becomes awkward.

pages.title: Stack The Boxes
pages.creator: NA
pages.description: Build a tower in Stack The Boxes. Click to release each box onto the pile below. Line up the drops carefully so the growing stack holds together instead of falling over.

pages.title: Rope Help
pages.creator: BPTop
pages.description: Rescue stick figures from a fire in Rope Help. Drag the rope to create a safe route around obstacles, then guide the group along it. Check the whole path so every character can reach safety.

pages.title: Body Toss
pages.creator: Good Funny Game
pages.description: Launch a person into the air in Body Toss. Use the mouse to control the throw and try to send the character higher. Watch the body's motion as you work toward a greater height.

pages.title: Multiplication Simulator
pages.creator: TapLabGames
pages.description: Practice times tables in Multiplication Simulator. Answer the multiplication tasks to collect green apples, while incorrect answers give red ones. A training option can help you learn, but using assistance does not earn a point for that answer.

pages.title: BTS Gta Cars Coloring
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Choose a car picture to decorate in BTS Gta Cars Coloring. Apply your preferred colors to the artwork using mouse or touch controls. Try different combinations to give each selected vehicle its own appearance.

pages.title: Merge Plants
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Combine two identical plants in Merge Plants. Each pair produces a new kind of plant, giving you another piece to work with. Continue finding matching plants to develop the collection through successive merges.

pages.title: Coordinates Rush
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Read grid positions in Coordinates Rush. Move the hero to the coordinate shown in the search box by selecting its square. Correct positions add 500 points, mistakes cost 200, and the challenge lasts three minutes.

pages.title: EG Touch Ball
pages.creator: EcapsGames.com
pages.description: Tap the balls to build a score in EG Touch Ball. Use mouse clicks or touch input to select the targets as they appear. Keep watching the play area and try to improve your total.

pages.title: Cartoon Trucks Memory
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Find matching truck pictures in Cartoon Trucks Memory. Turn over cards and remember their positions to locate each pair. Clear the matches to finish a level and continue through the remaining boards.

pages.title: Bonnie Gucci vs Prada
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Help choose a fashion label in Bonnie Gucci vs Prada. Try the available Gucci and Prada styling options on Bonnie and compare the resulting looks. Put together an outfit that suits the style you prefer.

pages.title: Cooking Fast: Hotdogs And Burgers Craze
pages.creator: Bofer Media (Twim Studio)
pages.description: Prepare orders in Cooking Fast: Hotdogs And Burgers Craze. Cook the food and serve each customer before their waiting time expires. Earn coins from your work and invest them in better cooking equipment.

pages.title: Space Geo Jump
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Keep moving upward through platforms in Space Geo Jump. Use the left and right sides of the screen to control the character's direction. Time your movement to handle the game's quick jumping pace.

pages.title: Battle For Kingdom
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Deploy soldiers to protect your land in Battle For Kingdom. Face waves of strange attackers, including muddy demons and toxic monsters. Choose from the available units and lead the army through the defense.

pages.title: Rope Swing
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Cross gaps by swinging from platform to platform in Rope Swing. Let the rope extend, then click to make a swing toward the next landing. Collect gems during the journey and use them to unlock other characters.

pages.title: Flappy Unicorn
pages.creator: MarketJS
pages.description: Flap between crystal pillars in Flappy Unicorn. Clear obstacles to collect gems, then spend them on powers such as shields, smaller size, or wider gaps. Keep the unicorn airborne while looking for space to pass.

pages.title: Drop 4
pages.creator: Code This Lab srl
pages.description: Drop discs into a grid in Drop 4. Form a horizontal, vertical, or diagonal line of four before your opponent does. Play against the computer or challenge a friend locally or through the multiplayer option.

pages.title: Anna Pregnancy Tattoo Care
pages.creator: Marutizgames
pages.description: Help Anna prepare for a decorative tattoo in Anna Pregnancy Tattoo Care. Give her food and complete the game's checkup activities before choosing the stomach design. Follow the prompts through each stage of the visit.

pages.title: Plumber Game
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Rotate pipe sections in Plumber Game. Join them into a continuous route that carries water to the fish. Examine the connections at each bend before turning another piece to finish the pipeline.

pages.title: Princess Top Fashion Looks
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Style Elsa with three clothing collections in Princess Top Fashion Looks. Explore floral prints, crochet dresses, and unicorn-themed outfits. Try the pieces together to create a different look from each fashion theme.

pages.title: Cubefield
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Navigate through a field of blocks in Cubefield. Use the mouse to steer into gaps and avoid hitting the cubes ahead. Watch the changing openings as you try to keep moving safely.

pages.title: Girls Night Out
pages.creator: Racz Ioan Paul II
pages.description: Prepare Sarah for an evening with friends in Girls Night Out. Choose clothing for the event and pair it with makeup that suits the outfit. Combine the available styling options to complete her going-out look.

pages.title: Crusader Defense 2
pages.creator: Casual_Azerion_Old
pages.description: Position troops to protect your castle in Crusader Defense 2. Another force of warriors is approaching, and your soldiers must stop it. Use the mouse to organize the defense and keep the attackers away from the stronghold.

pages.title: Mahjong Connect
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Clear paired tiles in Mahjong Connect. Find matching designs and connect the available pieces to remove them. Watch how each cleared pair opens the arrangement so you can continue working through the board.

pages.title: Dotted Girl Family Day
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Help care for twins in Dotted Girl Family Day. Clean the home, warm their milk, feed them, and change their diapers. Complete the household and baby-care activities with Dotted Girl during the family's day together.

pages.title: Barbie's Tropical Wedding
pages.creator: Bitent Media
pages.description: Help the bride prepare in Barbie's Tropical Wedding. Choose her wedding look from the available dress-up options before she walks down the aisle. Put the styling choices together for the tropical celebration.
